name: Digital Arts Inc.
summary: Digital Arts Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops and markets internet security software and appliances in Japan. The company offers i-FILTER, a web security product; m-FILTER, a mail security product; FinalCode, a file encryption and tracking solution; DigitalArts@Cloud, a comprehensive cloud security product that covers web browsing, email, and files; f-FILTER, a data protection and transfer solution; a-FILTER, an integrated authentication platform; and Z-FILTER, a network security product.
